settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account and preferences.
settings.account_session_sub: Manage your signed-in account and session state.
settings.appearance_sub: How CISA looks. Choose paper, dusk, or follow your device.
settings.language_sub: Choose your preferred interface and live translation language.
settings.roles_access_sub: Roles are labels — a way to know who carries what, and what each person sees.
settings.your_team_sub: Everyone with access to CISA. Their contacts, notes, and history stay with the work.
settings.no_matches: No teammates or invites match your search.
settings.walking_together_sub: Pair each trainee with a full-timer who walks alongside them. These pairs drive the trainee’s “your full-timer” and the full-timer’s trainee inbox.
settings.note_on_access_body: Approving or removing access takes effect right away. You can’t remove your own access or change your own role — that’s by design, so no one locks themselves out.
settings.what_people_telling_us_sub: Feedback from the team and the community. Read it like notes from friends.
settings.more_account_settings: More account settings will arrive in time.
